objectives.statement: Every service has a declared lifecycle stage and acceptance state.
AI/coding agents may propose and implement but cannot self-promote pass state.
Secrets are never embedded in source or receipts.
Provider and Drive transit require explicit provider receipt and no hidden data disclosure.
Deployment changes are branch/PR based and emit evidence artifacts.
Invalid states must be exercised by negative-space falsifiers.
M3/launchd/iostat/virtual CPU-GPU claims remain gated until host receipts exist.
